Xcite Value Bundle - XBS200-4 4 Ohm high-performance bass shaker bundle

 

The Value Bundle - XBS200-4 is designed as a strong foundation for building a serious tactile feedback system. As a bundle proposition, it focuses on delivering the force, control and installation flexibility needed for platforms, risers and heavy seating applications. The high-output bass shaker transfers controlled low-frequency energy into the structure, giving physical impact without relying on uncontrolled vibration.

 

The ultra-slim construction makes this bundle especially practical for compact or space-critical installations. The 62 mm total height, 230 mm outer diameter and minimal-footprint terminals help the XBS200-4 fit where larger tactile transducers are difficult to mount. Its SpiderCore motor architecture integrates the suspension into the motor core, supporting high excursion while keeping the low-profile format expected from modern tactile audio components.

 

Performance is built around serious mechanical capability, making the bundle suitable for demanding tactile setups rather than light vibration effects. The XBS200-4 uses a 178 mm, 4-layer voice coil, a 2590 g moving motor mass, 29.1 N/A BL and ±15 mm mechanical Xmax to create deep, physical impact. The 21.1 Hz resonance frequency supports infrasonic authority, while the rated force response extends from 10 Hz to 1 kHz for detailed tactile separation instead of a single-note rumble.

 

For installation, secure the unit with four high-tensile screws to a rigid frame or platform and pair the bundle with a suitable 4 Ohm amplifier in the 200 W to 1000 W range. A low-pass setting around 100 Hz is recommended for impact focus, or up to 150 Hz for extra tactile detail. The symmetric internal suspension allows vertical, inverted or sideways mounting, making it suitable for home cinema, simulator rigs, VR training and other home audio tactile feedback systems.
